description: This file defines the implementation class for SuiteCRM's v3.1 web services API, extending the base SugarWebServiceImpl class. It includes methods for CRUD operations, user authentication, module information retrieval, and search functionalities, with references to external dependencies such as other service and utility classes.

classes.name: SugarWebServiceImplv3_1
classes.description: Implements the SOAP web services for SuiteCRM v3.1, providing methods for CRUD operations, user login, module metadata retrieval, and search functionalities, utilizing helper utilities and external class dependencies.

methods.name: get_entry
methods.description: Retrieves a single SugarBean record based on ID, internally calls get_entries with a single ID.

methods.name: get_module_fields_md5
methods.description: Returns the MD5 hash of the module's vardef entries.

methods.name: get_module_layout_md5
methods.description: Returns the MD5 hash of the module's layout metadata for specific view types.

methods.name: get_entries
methods.description: Retrieves multiple SugarBean records by IDs, including related link data.

methods.name: set_entry
methods.description: Updates or creates a single SugarBean record based on provided field values.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Authenticates a user and initializes a session, returning user info and session ID.

methods.name: get_available_modules
methods.description: Returns the list of modules available to the logged-in user based on session.

methods.name: get_language_definition
methods.description: Retrieves language translation data for specified modules, optionally MD5 hashed.

methods.name: get_module_layout
methods.description: Retrieves layout metadata for modules, with optional MD5 hashing, for views like edit, detail, list.

methods.name: get_entry_list
methods.description: Returns a list of beans for a module based on a query, supporting pagination.

methods.name: search_by_module
methods.description: Performs a search across specified modules with search string, returning matching records.

methods.name: validateFields
methods.description: Validates a list of fields against module's bean definition before save.

methods.name: isIdField
methods.description: Checks if a given field in a bean is of type ID.

methods.name: validateId
methods.description: Validates that an ID field value matches the pattern expected for IDs.
